title: Veggie Burger with Balsamic BBQ Sauce, Portobello Mushrooms & Peppers

steps.text: Place vinegar, ketchup, sugar, soy sauce, Dijon, and spices in a small saucepan; stir to combine the BBQ sauce.
Bring sauce to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; slice lengthwise into ¼-inch thick strips. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, and slice mushrooms into ½-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl with the other veggies. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat.

Once the grill pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add veggies and cook, turning occasionally, until tender, 8-10 minutes. Transfer veggies to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Meanwhile, mince sun-dried tomatoes and capers; place both in the reserved bowl.
Add veggie ground and spices to the bowl with sun-dried tomatoes and capers; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the mixture into 4 equal-sized patties and place on another plate.

Once the veggies are done, return the grill pan to medium-high heat and coat with oil. Add patties and cook, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Once done, transfer to the plate with the veggies.

To assemble the burgers, layer the bottom half of each bun with a patty, BBQ sauce, and a small portion of grilled veggies; close with the top half of each bun. (Reserve remaining veggies for serving.)
To serve, divide burgers and remaining veggies between plates. Enjoy!
